text: おとこのこが　４にん　せんろのうえを　あるいてる…　…　ぼくも　もう　いかなきゃ！

structure.jp: せんろのうえを　あるいてる…　…
structure.en: are walking along the railroad tracks...

structure.jp: ぼくも　もう　いかなきゃ！
structure.en: I have to get going too!

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.explanation: なければならない on a verb means 'have to do it'. In casual talk it shrinks to なきゃ and the rest is dropped. いかなきゃ = 'I've got to go'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on right now. Here it is shortened to てる, as people do when talking. あるいてる = 'are walking'.

patterns.name: 〜を (path)
patterns.span: せんろのうえを　あるいてる
patterns.explanation: を with a moving verb shows the place you move along or through. せんろのうえを　あるいてる = 'are walking along the tracks'.
